disposition_meaning: A design route is recommended for later human review. This authorizes no implementation and no scientific execution.

decision.primary_route_name: Make the persistence/turnover trade-off the estimand (phase-structure route)
decision.a2_reason: If stage 2 returns EXCLUSION_CONFIRMED, further turnover restructuring would attempt to defeat a finding rather than test one; the correct next move is F.

rungs.1: a state variable stores past exposure
rungs.2: that state causally affects later behaviour
rungs.3: the state persists across material turnover
rungs.4: two entities can be causally addressed separately
rungs.5: intervention on A changes A's future differently from B's
rungs.6: the effect belongs specifically to A rather than its environment, a redundant copy or a relation

routes.name: turnover restructuring, clock-restructured
routes.reason: Choosing how much shorter requires calibration that can only come from the previous family's outcome distribution; it is retry-with-tuning under a new name.

routes.name: turnover restructuring, event-triggered
routes.reason_not_selected: Its negative result is only weakly informative; Route E subsumes its success case without tuning and has a strictly more informative negative.

routes.name: lineage-aware terminal semantics
routes.reason_not_selected: Changes the estimand from entity to lineage, so it answers a different question; and it targets a failure mechanism the program has not measured.

routes.name: new substrate or intervention geometry
routes.reason: The lattice-bond substrate is already the Route-C answer; changing again discards the designed rank-4 access algebra, restarts at Stage A, and a geometry chosen because it improves integrity is a geometry chosen to make entities more likely.

routes.name: addressability / intervention redesign
routes.admissible: on paper, but not as a next step
routes.status: THE DESTINATION, NOT THE NEXT MOVE
routes.reason: The rank-4 L x E factorial is already designed and is the only route that can reach rung 6, but it is Stage D and presupposes Stage C, which presupposes Stage B, which failed.

routes.name: phase-structure route: persistence/turnover trade-off as the estimand

hypotheses.H_X: operational persistence and material turnover are mutually exclusive at the declared scales
hypotheses.H_W: a non-empty region of the declared dimensionless span exhibits both simultaneously

routes.why_selected: Passes all twelve gates; subsumes A2's success case without tuning; adds independent turnover evidence via passive cohorts where the frozen family inferred turnover from the classifier; and converts an untestable precondition into a falsifiable structural claim whose negative is publishable.

routes.name: stop and consolidate
routes.highest_rung: reports rungs 1-2 as previously established at a low-dimensional level
routes.note: Passes all gates trivially and does not lose by default; becomes primary at every stop condition.

correction_1.claim_in_brief: the Stage-B failure reflected structural integrity loss such as SPLIT and LOST
correction_1.frozen_aggregate_record: the dominant class was persistence without turnover, followed by static shell/crystal and dissolution; TRACKING_UNRESOLVED, TURNOVER_WITHOUT_PERSISTENCE, PERCOLATED and ACTIVE_UNBOUNDED did not occur at all; every shard completed and replayed byte-identically
correction_1.reading: a persistence/turnover phase-structure problem, not a tracking problem
correction_1.used_only_to: reject routes premised on the wrong failure
correction_1.never_used_to: select any parameter, region, law index, horizon, cadence or duration

correction_2.claim: the Stage-B failure mechanism is formally unknown and knowably unknown
correction_2.basis: the autopsy returned AUDIT_INVALID and states that the world-level transition table, candidate-duration and censoring analysis, formation-versus-maintenance decomposition and parameter-region structure are intentionally absent rather than partially reported, and that no conclusion is permitted about the mechanism
correction_2.consequence: any route whose design is motivated by a specific failure mechanism builds on evidence the program does not have; this eliminates more routes than any other single fact

lifecycle_semantics.randomization_read_as: the opening of the declared observation window (Route E has no randomization)

pre_window.SPLIT: formation outcome in feasibility; ineligible-and-counted, never replaced, in a scientific family

post_window.SPLIT: primary outcome data in feasibility; competing event in a scientific family
post_window.MERGE: primary outcome data in feasibility; competing event AND identity-destroying in a scientific family
post_window.LOST: primary outcome data in feasibility; competing event in a scientific family

lifecycle_semantics.terminal_at_horizon: administrative censoring declared in advance; the estimand is horizon-indexed
lifecycle_semantics.missing_observation: global rejection of the world; never imputed
lifecycle_semantics.additional_requirement_for_scientific_fa: a predeclared competing-risk estimand stating before data whether the target is a cumulative incidence among identity-preserving entities, a lineage-level quantity, or a composite

association_edge_schema.hard_prohibition: no resolved-winner field; a schema admitting chosen_successor is inadmissible regardless of how it is populated

provenance_decision.honest_formulation: self-consistent, independently reproducible, and attributable only to the extent that the human-review chain is trusted
provenance_decision.anti_discard_property_from: one-shot execution discipline declared before data, bound by the human-review record

analysis_access_consumption.required_shape: analyze_future_family(run_directory, tracking, sampled_frames, preregistration_id, analysis_code_id) internally calls open_analysis_access immediately before analysis; the capability is non-transferable and non-persistent
analysis_access_consumption.forgery_by_subclass_or_reflection: confirmed and outside the qualified threat model; made irrelevant rather than prevented

cadence_decision.why_route_e_can_operate: the sampling schedule is declared in advance as part of the estimand and classification uses complete frame pairs at that schedule; the runner fails closed and records a global rejection if any declared position cannot be realised as a complete pair, so there is no situation in which it discovers mid-run that it needs an unplanned pair
cadence_decision.if_ever_needed: a separate tracker repair and requalification mission that must precede runner wiring

stages.name: prospective scientific execution (Stage C then D)

feasibility_architecture.no_replacement_rule: enrollment fixed at declaration; a world that fails is recorded, counted in attrition and never replaced; the denominator is always the enrolled set
feasibility_architecture.attrition_accounting: every enrolled world resolves to exactly one terminal state; attrition is a complete partition of the enrolled set with pre-window and post-window failures separated; a family whose attrition cannot be partitioned is FEASIBILITY_INVALID
feasibility_architecture.eligibility: declared before data, computed from pre-window state only; post-window information may never enter eligibility
admissible_threshold_sources: analytic or dimensional bounds from the frozen equations
code-only synthetic qualification against constructed must-pass and must-fail cases
a declared invariant such as exhaustive single-terminal accounting

contamination_barriers: atlas blindness: the agent deriving the dimensionless span must not have read the Stage-B regime atlas; THIS DOCUMENT'S AUTHOR HAS READ IT and is therefore disqualified from specifying the span
no parameter transfer from any previous family
stage isolation: separate family, namespace, preregistration and human review per stage
diagnosis quarantine: any future Stage-B diagnostic reconstruction must not feed the span
one-shot execution: exactly one runner invocation per family, no retry, replacement, adaptive extension or threshold change
prerequisite_chain: M1 wire the gate into a real runner
M3 manifest extension: preregistration + analysis identity
M9 Stage D rank-4 L x E access factorial
stop_conditions: any threshold traces to a previous family's outcome
intentionally_postponed: Stage D rank-4 access factorial and therefore rung 6
the diagnostic reconstruction of the closed Stage-B family
any repair of the empty-right-frame / non-unit-cadence path

claim.claimed: Route E is the strongest admissible prospective route: it passes all twelve frozen admissibility gates, reaches claim-ladder rung 3 at world unit without changing the estimand to lineage, subsumes the success case of turnover restructuring without historical tuning, and has a symmetric, publishable interpretation in both directions.
not_claimed: That any scientific execution is authorized.
That entities will form, persist, remember or be individuated.
That the Stage-B failure mechanism is known.
That ownership is reachable by the selected route.
That rung 7 is reachable by any single family.
That the architecture is tamper-proof or cryptographically trustworthy.
